_comment: Quality scorecard rubric - blends deterministic AI-SEO dimensions with LLM-judge subjective dimensions into one 0-100 composite. Consumed by core/content_validator.py:build_scorecard and eval/run_quality_eval.py.
_geo_basis: Princeton GEO (KDD 2024): cite sources +40%, statistics +37%, quotations +30%, authoritative tone +25%, clarity +20%, keyword stuffing -10%. Authority/AEO dimensions are weighted highest because that is where citations + statistics are scored.
_regression_threshold_note: Composite point drop (vs committed baseline) that fails the eval harness / CI gate. A 3-point drop on a 0-100 composite flags a meaningful regression while tolerating scorer noise.

judge._note: Subjective GEO factors that deterministic regex cannot measure. Scored 0-100 each by core/quality_judge.py via SmartAIRouter model_precision with reasoning disabled. A dimension that fails to parse is recorded as null + error and excluded from the composite - never faked as a pass.
